A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for the first-time homebuyer, fee-based home purchase financing program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYER, FEE-BASED HOME PURCHASE FINANCING. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the first-time homebuyer, fee-based home purchase financing program established in Laws 2023, chapter 37, article 2, section 12, as amended in Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 15, section 44. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for the first-time homebuyer, fee-based home purchase financing program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYER, FEE-BASED HOME PURCHASE FINANCING.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the first-time homebuyer, fee-based home purchase financing program established in Laws 2023, chapter 37, article 2, section 12, as amended in Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 15, section 44. This is a onetime appropriation.
